## Validation approach

::: columns

::: {.column width="30%"}

- Independent validation with national field plot data (MAGPlot)

- Over 50,000 plots across Canada

- Comparison by 20-year age classes

:::

::: {.column width="70%"}

![](images/validation/magplot.png){fig-align="center"}

:::

:::

::: notes
MAGPlot: harmonized national field-plot database, >50,000 plots from multiple
jurisdictions. Observations are not distributed uniformly. Observations are summarized
in 20-year age classes so heavily sampled ages do not dominate the assessment.
:::

## Validation results {.unstretch}

::: {.pdf-scroll-viewport}
![](images/validation/curves_vs_plot_all_models_tall.png){.nostretch fig-align="center"}

::: notes
Full comparison between fitted curves and independent field observations. Look for
whether the curves follow the general age-related pattern in the field observations.

## Validation - overall performance

::: columns

::: {.column width="45%"}
![](images/scatterplots_RSYC.png){fig-align="center"}
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}

|                 | **AGB**        | **Volume**     |
|-----------------|---------------:|---------------:|
| Median R²       | 0.63           | 0.62           |
| Median RMSE     | 37.1 Mg ha⁻¹   | 67.6 m³ ha⁻¹   |
| Median bias     | −12.2 Mg ha⁻¹  | −10.7 m³ ha⁻¹  |


- **Best species-specific models:** subalpine fir, eastern white-cedar, and trembling aspen; black spruce

- **Weakest models** yellow birch, Sitka spruce, and tamarack


:::

:::

::: notes
Median R² 0.63 (AGB) and 0.62 (volume). Median RMSE ~37 Mg/ha and ~68 m³/ha. Bias
modest and negative for both. Substantial variation among species.
:::
